authoredLandmarksRequired.name: Sydney Opera House
authoredLandmarksRequired.reason: Authored in sydney/landmarks/opera_house.gd from its own OSM reference.

limitations: Stage B is the inner Sydney CBD and its neighbouring districts, not Greater Sydney.

Building footprints are OSM-derived only inside the pipeline's original 1.2 x 1.4 km sample box (972 footprints). Every other parcel is a DERIVED subdivision of a real OSM road-bounded block; its height is an authored district range, not a surveyed measurement.
The public Overpass endpoint was unreachable during this phase (expired TLS certificate and 502), so no additional OSM building footprints could be collected for the expanded area.
Footpaths and crossings remain derived from road geometry, as in Stage A.
Elevation is absent; all geometry sits on y = 0. Existing landmark elevations are unchanged.
North of the Harbour Bridge (Milsons Point, Luna Park, Kirribilli, North Sydney) is deliberately excluded.
West of Broadway was spliced from the inner-west export (real OSM roads/buildings for Glebe, Camperdown and Annandale).
West of x=-2700 was spliced from the inner-west export (second splice extending to x=-5500, covering Leichhardt/Lilyfield/Haberfield/Ashfield area).
